title: Core: axis-aligned bounding box for rotated/scaled shapes
description: The current getBounds or bounding box helpers likely return width/height without accounting for rotation or scale transforms. Add/fix getTransformedBounds(obj: DisplayObject): {x,y,width,height} in packages/core/src/engine/ that computes the axis-aligned bounding box for a rotated+scaled shape or symbol instance. Used by AlignPanel, snapping, and selection hit testing. A rotated 100x50 rect at 45 degrees should have an AABB of roughly 106x106. Add 6 tests.
